神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：生活在古代，The verb for residing normally takes a physical place; a time period needs a verb meaning to live in an era. [rule: none]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，At first mention, introduce the character with both a name and a brief identifying noun phrase rather than assuming the reader already knows him. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 常常生病了：常常生病，A habitual condition uses the zero particle; 了 marks a completed event or change of state. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，This is a completed travel event in the narrative, so the verb takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “住在古代” is acceptable Chinese; “生活在古代” is only an optional stylistic change.
This is the character’s first appearance, so the teacher requires an introductory phrase rather than the name alone.
常常 describes a habitual condition, so 生病 should not take 了.
The travel to these places is presented as a completed narrative event, so 去 needs 了.
